question: What percentage of midterm election Novembers have seen stock market gains historically?
transcript_excerpt: According to Morningstar research studying a century of market performance, stocks have risen in the month of November in 21 of the past 25 midterm election years, which equals 84% of the time. Morningstar strategist Dan Lefkowitz concluded that the post-election pop is real, regardless of election results.
